description: November 9 birthday meaning: Scorpio decan 2, birthday number 9, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a November 9 birthday falls in Scorpio, in the second decan, with Pluto as the sign's ruler and Neptune as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 9. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Scorpio is fixed and water.

sections.heading: The November 9 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: November 9 brings together two of the most compassionate symbols on offer. Neptune, sub-ruling the second decan at sixteen degrees of Scorpio, deepens empathy, and the birthday number 9 is associated with service and universal concern. The traditional reading is a person who feels other people's pain keenly and often finds purpose through helping, mentoring or advocacy.

Astronomically, November 9 puts the Sun near 16° Scorpio in most years, inside the second ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Neptune. From 10 to 19 degrees of Scorpio, the sub-ruler is Neptune, modern ruler of Pisces. Early-to-mid November birthdays tend to soften the sign's intensity with intuition, imagination and empathy. These Scorpios are often seen as perceptive in an almost uncanny way, reading undercurrents in a room and drawn to art, healing work or spiritual questions. Neptune can blur edges, so feelings may be absorbed from others or idealised beyond recognition. The combination is powerful when grounded: deep emotional insight paired with compassion, used to help people face what they would rather not see alone.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for November 9
paragraphs: Born on the 9th, your birthday number is 9, the last and broadest of the single digits. Numerologists see the birth day as a secondary number that describes a natural gift. The 9 is traditionally associated with compassion, idealism and a wide view of humanity, perhaps because it contains something of every number before it. Those with this birthday often find themselves helping, teaching or creating for audiences beyond their own circle. Letting go can be a recurring theme for 9s, along with learning that finishing one chapter makes space for a better one.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a November 9 birthday gives Life Path 3 for 1990, 22 for 2000, 5 for 2010 and 6 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 11 and 22. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous November 9 birthdays
paragraphs: A November birthday falls in late autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of bare branches and early dusk, and in late spring for the southern, when the days lengthen fast. Scorpio holds most of the month, with Sagittarius arriving around November 22. In numerology November is month 11, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced and linked with intuition and inspiration. November 9 is the 313rd day of the year (314th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Sagittarius, is usually complete within 14 days, by November 23.

By November 9 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a November 9 birthday are Ivan Turgenev (1818), Carl Sagan (1934) and Muhammad Iqbal (1877).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is November 9?
faq.answer: November 9 is Scorpio in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Scorpio, which tradition links with Neptune.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on November 9?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On November 9 the Life Path is 9 in 1960, 1 in 1970, 11 in 1980, 3 in 1990, 22 in 2000, 5 in 2010 and 6 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 9 for everyone born on the 9th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on November 9?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by November 9, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on November 9?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on November 9 include Ivan Turgenev (1818), Carl Sagan (1934) and Muhammad Iqbal (1877). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
